text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while taking a walk in the park,
I was suddenly called out to by a familiar voice.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! My savior!
Trainer, over here for a sec~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, what do you know.
I'm sure glad you happened to pass by.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, we'd like to ask you
to be the matchmaker for our wedding."

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Father, is that person the "matchmaker"?
Then let's get started, hurry, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking in the direction of the voice, I saw a little boy and girl, about kindergarten age, sitting happily together on a picnic mat.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well now... As it turns out, I ended up being both the priest and the MC for these kids' pretend wedding.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, they insisted they wouldn't do it without a matchmaker... tahaha.
So, um... sorry to ask, but could you please help us out with this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... to help out a troubled
Matikanetannhauser, I decided to take on
the role of matchmaker, but—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, groom and bride.
Do you take each other in sickness and in health,
and promise to love one another?

text_block_list.name: Bride and Groom
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
What a wonderful answer~.
Your vow passes the test!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...So, what were we supposed to do after this again?
Uhmm, let's see—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
…………
Since we're here, I shall make a vow as well.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
In sickness and in health,
I vow to make them swear to absolutely everything.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"And as the matchmaker—you must swear to mediate
every single thing between them,
no matter what. Understood?"

text_block_list.name: Groom Boy
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, big sis.
Isn't this wedding ceremony
kinda way too close?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What are you saying!?
This is indeed a time-honored ceremony!
Next up is, um, let's see...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The ceremony, which had barely been holding together, finally began to completely fall apart—and that was when it happened.

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Girl
text_block_list.text:
—Hey! What do you think you're doing getting
married without me, Ma-kun?!

text_block_list.name: Groom Boy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? W-Wait a sec...!
This is just a game...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What?
What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Girl
text_block_list.text:
A game? Oh, is that so. What a ridiculous joke.
...You must have felt real good, didn't you?
Toying with a maiden's heart and laughing behind her back!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I don't really get it,
nor do I really want to, but in short...
this is total mayhem!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Fighting is not allowed!
As an adult, I must put a stop to this!
Let's go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—Right! Okay! Attention, everyone!
Do you know just who we have in our presence here?!

text_block_list.name: Bride Girl
text_block_list.text: Who else could it be... but the matchmaker, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes! They are a matchmaker who bridges any divide in this world!
Therefore, everyone must cease fighting in their presence!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Girl
text_block_list.text: What is that?! Doing something like that without asking...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Matchmaker Beam, fire!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
See, now everyone's become good friends.
Alright then, let's the three of us play together from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Matikanetannhauser's quick thinking(?),
the quarrel was instantly defused.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Making them swear their vows at any time—
this is my way as a priest.
choice_data_list: You're like a big sister to everyone.
You're like a big sister to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh! Now let us continue with the Reverend's wise Solomon-like judgment.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"To avoid turning things into a bloodbath like this,
Big Sis thinks you all need
to learn a lot more about romance."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So! This Father Machitan will now
give you all a lecture on love!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Umm, well, first point number 1!
Don't tell just anyone that you love them!
And nextâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Less about romance and more about common sense. But in any case, Machikane Tannhauser had successfully given the preschoolers a moral lesson in her own unique way.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mhfufu. I've always been good
with little kids. Like breaking up fights
between my little brother and his friends.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, as for the rest of the wedding...
That's just gonna get messy again, so let's play something else~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Do you want to play tag? Red Light, Green Light?
Whatever we do, promise me you'll all get along!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The five of them played together for a while... and the kids made up completely.
